Yuga Labs Launches Mudwater Trading Cards on Solana, Opens Claims for BAYC and MAYC Holders Yuga Labs, the company behind BAYC, has launched Mudwater, a physical and digital trading card collection on Solana, with claims now open to BAYC and MAYC holders. The collection features 120 artworks, including foil, numbered, and rare editions. Each BAYC NFT entitles its holder to 10 packs, while each MAYC NFT qualifies for two packs, with 10 cards per pack. The project also allocates 2.5% of Mudwater card trading volume to purchase APE tokens, which are distributed to collectors proportionally based on their card holdings. Totems, packs, and cards are now tradable on OpenSea. — link

Highlight Clip: Justin Sun on His WLFI Investment: He Would Invest Again, Saying the Decision Was Almost Inevitable at the Time Justin Sun on His WLFI Investment: He Would Invest Again, Saying the Decision Was Almost Inevitable at the Time TRON founder Justin Sun said in an October 14 interview with Bonnie Blockchain that if he could go back in time, he would still invest in World Liberty Financial (WLFI). He said much of the relevant information only became known to him after the investment and had not been fully disclosed at the time, making it difficult for him to have made a different decision or feel regret. Speaking about his childhood, Sun said being sent to a boarding school in Wuhan at age nine, followed by his parents' divorce, completely changed his life and forced him to become independent and make his own decisions at a very young age. — link

Nine US Companies Object to Tokenized Trading on OKXICE According to an OKXICE public notice dated October 15, the platform has received issuer objections from nine companies — Cerebras, AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave, Verizon, Applied Optoelectronics, Broadcom and UnitedHealth — meaning their shares will not be offered for tokenized trading on OKXICE TSV. OKXICE LLC is 50% owned by ICE, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and 50% by OKC USA, and plans to offer 24/7 tokenized U.S. equity trading through a permissioned Uniswap v4 AMM on XLayer. — link

Highlight Clip: Justin Sun: Sold 80–90% of ETH at $3,600–$4,000, Then Bought Heavily Into US Stocks Justin Sun: Sold 80–90% of ETH at $3,600–$4,000, Then Bought Heavily Into US Stocks On October 16, 2026, Justin Sun said in an interview with William Joy that he had sold 80–90% of his ETH position at around $3,600–$4,000, keeping only a core holding and had not bought back in as of the interview. He said ETH appeared to have formed a fragile double top, prompting him to cut his position sharply, while leaving his core Bitcoin holdings untouched. He subsequently bought heavily into US stocks, expecting capital to concentrate in that market. — link
